lines.ko: 도전장을 받은 친구는 같은 문제를 풉니다.
lines.en: A friend who gets the challenge plays the same questions.
enLines: A friend who gets the challenge

lines.ko: 진 쪽이 답을 외워 다시 이겼습니다.
lines.en: The loser memorized the answers and won the replay.

lines.ko: 같은 문제를 또 풀면 기록에 안 남습니다.
lines.en: Now if you replay the same questions, it doesn't go on your record.
enLines: Now if you replay the same questions,
it doesn't go on your record.

lines.ko: 맞힐 때마다 쌓이는 경험치도 안 줍니다.
lines.en: You don't get the experience points you earn for each right answer, either.
enLines: You don't get the experience points
you earn for each right answer, either.

lines.en: Challenges work in the game where you pick real or fake.
enLines: where you pick real or fake.

lines.ko: 이름 넷 중 진짜를 찾는 게임에도 붙였습니다.
lines.en: I added them to the game where you find the one real name out of four, too.
keywordsEn: the one real name out of four
enLines: I added them to the game where you find
the one real name out of four, too.

lines.ko: 도전장이 얼마나 오가는지 세어 볼 겁니다.
lines.en: Next, I'll count how many challenges go back and forth.
lines.art: a hand-held tally counter beside paper planes flying between two small houses

lines.en: Now only the first game counts as a win.
